After/fig:arrows
Flow drawn from the frame names, so moving a frame does not break it.
Solid arrow with a pill label — a transition. Dashed vertical line, no arrowhead — a [state] group binding a screen to its own variants. The flow lives in the frame names (login_default --> signup_default), so rearranging the canvas and running /fig:arrows again redraws it in place.
